description.narrative:
Knowledge sharing of best practices of sustainable transitions of societies plays a fundamental role in achieving the goals set out 2023-agenda. A partnership between the Danish embassy in Brazil and the Brazilian Think-Tank CEBRI aims to create a space for open dialogue on relevant topics where Denmark and Brazil have a lot to learn from one another.
The objective of the project is to build knowledge and capacity within key topics related to sustainable development key Brazilian stakeholders and lawmakers via a series of seminars. The seminars are expected to take place at the Danish residence in Brasilia, however it is possible that one or two seminars will be held as part of CEBRI’s T20 mandate during the Brazilian G20 presidency and for these events, location in either São Paulo or Rio de Janeiro could be an option.
The intended impact is to engage with Brazilian stakeholders and lawmakers with a view to strengthen sustainable policy development within the four topics of the project and foster further exchange of knowledge and ideas for mutual benefit.
